description: This file implements the TpmRandomSource class, which provides methods to generate and add entropy to a TPM (Trusted Platform Module) using the TSS2 library. It interacts with TPM resources, calls external TPM functions, and handles TPM random number generation and entropy stirring.

classes.name: TpmRandomSource
classes.description: A class that provides TPM-based random number generation and entropy addition functionalities.

methods.name: GenerateRandom
methods.description: Generates random bytes using the TPM's RNG, filling the provided buffer.

methods.name: AddRngEntropy
methods.description: Adds entropy to the TPM's RNG from an external buffer.
